entries.name: BHPS non-overlap sensitivity (exclude spanning individuals)
entries.objective: Exclude the spanning (BHPS-USoc overlap) individuals from the BHPS sample; refit GMM and recompute persistence on the BHPS-only remainder; report whether the headline BHPS conclusions hold without the overlap individuals.

key_params.exclude: spanning individuals (BHPS individuals also present in USoc)

decision_rule.primary: On the BHPS-only remainder, the persistence headline is preserved iff H0 W2 still rejects at alpha=0.05 AND the H1 asymmetry direction is unchanged vs full-BHPS (H1 does not newly reject in the opposite direction).
decision_rule.secondary: Regime structure is stable iff ARI(BHPS-only GMM vs full-BHPS GMM labels on the shared remainder individuals) >= 0.9.

outcomes.supported: primary preserved -> P01-A section 6.2 non-overlap / 'replication' reframing is supportable: the BHPS topological signal is not an artefact of the USoc overlap.
outcomes.overlap_dependent: primary NOT preserved -> disclose overlap-dependence; the section 6.2 reframing is not licensed and the dependence must be reported.

decision_rule.ari_note: The secondary ARI rule is a regime-stability descriptor reported alongside; the primary persistence rule governs the section 6.2 prose direction.
